analysis.multiple_comparisons: none; every registered trajectory, graph, control, and mutation gate is conjunctive
analysis.stopping_rule: validate source and predecessor bindings before scientific work; process 12 graph cells and 24 initialized trajectories in declared order; stop before the next stage on an exactness, 15-second wall, 64-MiB traced-Python, or one-MiB artifact breach
analysis.uncertainty: none; the two fair schedules form an exact finite distribution with rational weights

budget.execution: strictly sequential; standard library only; no RNG or worker subprocesses

claim_boundary: registered three-program total source-table language only
canonical DDD/DCC/DDD catalog with costs 1,2,3 and initial profile (p1,p1)
two exact payoff families with R=3 and temptation in {299/100,3,301/100}
deterministic alternating inertial best response with minimum attached-cost tie-breaking
fair scheduler means the exact half-row-first half-column-first finite distribution
complete augmented-state graphs and basins only for the 12 registered canonical cells

no basin-general result outside those finite graphs, mixed or stochastic equilibrium selection, unrestricted programs, proof agents, language models, real cooperation, deployment, or ASMP-12 resolution
experimental_unit: one deterministic initialized trajectory for one family, temptation, budget, and first-mover schedule; graph states and robustness replays are repeated exact checks, not independent units

hypotheses.falsifier: any budget-two initialized trajectory is noncooperative, any budget-three T<=R trajectory leaves (p1,p1), or any budget-three T>R trajectory remains cooperative
hypotheses.prediction: the 24 canonical trajectories contain exactly 20 cooperative and 4 noncooperative selections

hypotheses.falsifier: a terminal initialized profile is absent from the pure-equilibrium set or its trace does not reach the reported graph attractor
hypotheses.prediction: every selected profile is an available pure equilibrium and every initialized trace is bound to its complete augmented-state attractor

hypotheses.falsifier: the repaired catalog loses initialized cooperation or the source-blind control changes selection between normalized budgets two and three
hypotheses.prediction: repair removes the budget effect while source blindness exhibits identical budget-two and budget-three outcomes, including early vulnerability above R

hypotheses.falsifier: cost padding or any simultaneous semantic relabeling changes a mapped trace, graph relation, or selected distribution
hypotheses.prediction: attached-cost selection is invariant to +2 cost padding and covariant under all six program/source relabelings

denominators.primary_trajectory: one graph cell and one first-mover schedule
denominators.robustness_replay: one semantic trajectory under one frozen encoding transformation

exposure.activation: p2 is a unique profitable best response to p1 exactly when budget=3 and T>R
exposure.eligibility: the inherited initial profile is (p1,p1) and the relevant programs are admitted
exposure.state_change: the first scheduled mover leaves p1 for p2 in each live canonical condition

model.code_hash: the required --source-commit must contain byte-identical copies of exactly the eight source-freeze files
model.rng: none; fair scheduling is an exact two-atom distribution, not a random draw
model.update_order: row-first or column-first, then strict alternation; incumbent stays when already an exact best response, otherwise the unique minimum attached-cost best response is chosen

question: Under one fully specified finite selection dynamic, does admitting the canonical duplicate exploiter change which pure equilibrium is reached from the inherited cooperative profile?

seed_plan.pairing: deterministic symbolic cells; no RNG or stochastic replicate

source_freeze.ignored_live_cache_policy: none; caches and every ninth entry are unexpected
source_freeze.import_safe_launch: run.py and verify_independent.py require Python isolated safe-path mode (-I) before any non-builtin import
source_freeze.live_directory_policy: exactly the eight frozen regular non-reparse files
